player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered the Balcony twice without exploring the other available directions (north and south) in between, causing me to miss the Dining room and Bedroom. Next time, I will strictly follow a systematic path: from the Nursery, go south to the Balcony; immediately from the Balcony, go west to the Dining room; then from the Dining room, go north to the Bedroom; finally, go south from the Bedroom to the Lobby. Only after visiting all unique rooms will I issue the "DONE" command.
